text:
Katie (partnerships): Heads up — OrionCloud changed their manifest. They can deliver ~60% of our reserved racks 2 weeks early, but the remaining 40% won’t ship until late Q3. tagging @Samir @Marco to triage. 😬
Samir (logistics): ugh. do we have serials for the early units? any single-rack dependencies?
Katie (partnerships): VendorOps Bot posted the update — docs attached. Not all SKUs match our reserved SKU mapping, there are two PSUs that differ.
VendorOps Bot: OrionCloud manifest update: manifest_id=OC-98431, early_shipment_qty=12 racks, delayed_qty=8 racks, delta_psu_model=APX-400->APX-420, est_delayed_ship=2024-10-15. Link: https://vendor.orioncloud/manifest/OC-98431
Marco (procurement): We reserved 20 racks for customer commitments — 12 early / 8 late is the split. If APX-420 is incompatible with our standard rack image we need either a swap or a firmware SKU exception. @Jordan any product constraints?
Jordan (product): APX-420 changes power draw and BMC firmware. Could work in Dedicated staging with a slightly different build. Main risk is on-prem bundles — we need cert for PSU shift. For Hosted/Retail pools it's fine.
Samir (logistics): Operational options: 1) accept 12 early into a temporary holding pool (quarantine + quick smoke), 2) ask vendor to re-route some early units to customers already provisioned, 3) push back all until uniform delivery (probably costs). What are contract levers?
Marco (procurement): Contract has a partial-delivery clause and credits for late items, but early-delivery reassignments are at our discretion. We can also request vendor to replace PSUs on early racks before shipping — cost shared? I'll open convo.
Katie (partnerships): Customer impact: two Dedicated pilots expecting full 4-rack sets. Splitting sets will break their onboarding. We should avoid splitting pilot sets. Customers flagged: AcmeLabs, BetaHealth.
Jordan (product): Proposal: hold the 12 early racks off-market, use them to cover non-pilot capacity (dev/staging), and request vendor to prioritize replacing 4 racks so at least one pilot set is complete. Meanwhile give customers a firm date window for the remaining 8.
Samir (logistics): I can run an acceptance + swap plan: quick PSU swap at our staging in SEA, smoke test 2 days, then either send to retail pool or ship to pilot. Need tools & labels updated. I'll raise a runbook.
Marco (procurement): I'll ask OrionCloud for SKU replacement or credit. If they won't swap, ask for partial refund + expedited Q3 delivery for the 8. Also check whether warranty/serial changes affect our spares inventory.
Katie (partnerships): Sounds good. Next steps: Marco to open vendor negotiation (by EOD), Samir to draft staging runbook (tomorrow), Jordan to list pilot-set constraints for customer success, I'll inform AcmeLabs & BetaHealth with two options. We'll reconvene 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:
